## Product Case Studies

- [WorkIndia - OTP Onboarding & Activation](https://sayanbanerjee.pages.dev/#wi-otp-case-card): Verification was the biggest activation drop-off - so logins skip OTP entirely on a saved token, and registrations run a four-channel fallback ladder. **Results: 96.3% OTP success, 96.6% 5-sec delivery, 98.2% login segment.**
- [WorkIndia - Job Discovery & Apply Conversion](https://sayanbanerjee.pages.dev/#wi-discovery-case-card): The survey said WhatsApp, and the CTA won +30% - but apply rate was still short, so I built a click heatmap and found the real cause. **Results: +30% Lands-to-Apply, +6% applies (density), +8.1% applies (ranking).**
- [WorkIndia - CLM Channel Efficiency & Lifecycle Growth](https://sayanbanerjee.pages.dev/#wi-clm-case-card): Spend was outgrowing DAU, so send-time became a contextual bandit rewarded on applications rather than opens - plus algorithm reuse and a new email channel. **Results: −23% cost per DAU, +17% DAU, ₹1.2L infra saved.**
- [WorkIndia - Acquisition Funnel Experimentation](https://sayanbanerjee.pages.dev/#wi-acquisition-case-card): A 1M+ daily visitor funnel was being changed on intuition, so I installed a hypothesis → power → guardrail loop and gated rollout on significance. **Results: +6.2% Clicks-to-Leads, 1M+ daily visitors, Stat-sig rollout gate.**
- [Hevo Data - Funnel Conversion Engine](https://sayanbanerjee.pages.dev/#hevo-case-card): Technical evaluators couldn't estimate cost before talking to sales - so I gave them a calculator, and a chatbot on the content pages that fed it. **Results: +9% qualified leads, 80+ ETL pipelines, 50+ blogs instrumented.**
- [Samsung Prism - LLM Safety Guardian](https://sayanbanerjee.pages.dev/#samsung-case-card): Unexplained moderation flags were expensive to review - so every flag got an explanation grounded in the exact policy clause it allegedly violated. **Results: 86.3% accuracy, −40% false positives, 32,000+ documents.**

## Experience

- **WorkIndia** (May 2025 - Present) — Data Analyst — Growth & Product (CLM). De facto PM for Candidate Growth; owns the CLM roadmap across acquisition, activation and retention.
- **Hevo Data** (Jun 2024 - Dec 2024) — Technical Research Analyst. 80+ distributed ETL pipelines; built a Snowflake pricing tool that lifted qualified leads 9%.
- **Samsung Prism** (Nov 2023 - May 2024) — R&D Intern. Transformer classification and summarization plus RAG explainability for app policy moderation.

## Experimentation Systems

- **Notification Time Affinity Model (Contextual Thompson Sampling)** — Send-time as a contextual bandit - rewarded on downstream value, bounded by fatigue caps.
- **A/B Design on a 1M+ Visitor Funnel** — Stated hypothesis, powered sample size, pre-declared guardrails, significance gate before rollout.
- **Progressive Fallback Ladder (OTP)** — Channel recovery as a measured sequence - each rung ordered by evidence, measured on its own.
- **Diagnose → Ship → Re-diagnose** — The loop for when your first fix works and the metric still doesn't move.
- **Composite & Efficiency Metric Design** — Metrics built so a campaign can't win by sacrificing user trust, and so channels compare on one number.
- **Segment Refresh → Copy Regeneration Loop** — A 14-day cycle that doesn't just re-bucket users - it regenerates the copy those users receive.

## Writing

- [Fine-Tuning StarCoder2 on Google Colab (T4 GPU)](https://medium.com/codex/finetuning-starcoder2-on-google-colab-t4-gpu-a7a416efde4e): A hands-on guide to fine-tuning large code models using limited compute. Covers LoRA-based optimization, memory-efficient training, and practical trade-offs when working with Colab GPUs.
- [Understanding the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis](https://medium.com/@sayan112207/understanding-the-lottery-ticket-hypothesis-7d303f60616c): Breaks down how sparse subnetworks can outperform full models, and what this means for efficient deep learning, model pruning, and scalable deployment strategies.
